items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions the interviewee told Ira Gitler something, and Ira Gitler wrote about it in a book. The interviewee does not describe a personal interaction with Gitler, only that Gitler recorded their statement.

ctx.x: They were all kind of that idea. When I realized that they were playable I had that in mind certainly.

The first session you did was in January and that was put out under Lennie’s name. I think you told Ira Gitler that you just wanted to do it as a sideman; you didn’t want to be the leader on that. Is that so?
I certainly respected Lennie enough to give him that title.
